title: A Claude root session mid-turn is listed as "idle" (preview "Thinking"), so senders and the coordinator misread a live session
outcome:
A session whose turn is running is listed as active by termal_list_sessions and the session status. Mail sent to it is labelled as queued behind its active turn, not as delivered to an idle session.

Observed 2026-10-01 about 15:27Z by Termal::Fable2. termal_list_sessions showed Termal::Opus2 (session-8111) with status "idle" and preview "Thinking". By Opus2's own report (TermAl mailbox 4daa5b87 #556), he was in one long turn since about 15:16Z, writing code in .tmp/wt-stuck-session. A probe sent at about 15:27Z returned notificationDisposition "deliveredToIdleSession" while that turn was running, and he read it mid-turn. The same session had listed "idle" with a "Thinking" preview earlier (about 08:31Z), while its gate was running.

Why it matters: the coordinator decides whether to wake a peer, or to report a stuck session to Greg, from this listing. A wrong "idle" invites needless wakes, and it may also bear on the wake-dispatch race w-3bd74078208d (a wake marked delivered-to-idle while a turn is live). Related: w-f23a694c9bc5 (held visibility).
acceptance: A mailbox message sent to a session mid-turn is labelled as queued behind its active turn, not delivered to an idle session; a test covers it.
The full five-stage gate passes on the exact reviewed tree, its run directory and fingerprint cited in a note.
While a Claude root session's turn is running, termal_list_sessions and the session status report it as active; a test covers a long turn with extended thinking or tool calls in progress.
